title: Deal Type
description: Type of programmatic deal on an SSP platform.

enumDescriptions.curated: Curated marketplace deal — curator packages inventory from multiple publisher sources with audience or contextual enrichment
enumDescriptions.pmp: Private marketplace deal — invitation-only auction with floor price, single publisher or curated supply
enumDescriptions.preferred_deal: Fixed-price deal with first-look priority, no impression guarantee
enumDescriptions.programmatic_guaranteed: Guaranteed delivery at fixed price with committed impression volume (non-auctioned)
